precondition: view stack non-empty; Press or Repeat
behaviour: Key goes to the top view only; the composer receives nothing while any view is open.
notes: list handle_key_event at bottom_pane/list_selection_view.rs:1299-1301

precondition: any view open; key kind Release
behaviour: Release is passed to handle_key_release on every view in the stack, then dropped; the top view never sees it.

precondition: two or more views; Press or Repeat
behaviour: Covered views (all but the top) observe the key through observe_key_event_while_covered before the top view handles it.

precondition: a view was opened by a key inside the activation guard window
behaviour: The activation key is consumed before routing, so the press that opened the view cannot act on it.
notes: not a candidate: suppress_current_view_key_until_release (bottom_pane/mod.rs:2065-2083) and consume_view_transition_key (bottom_pane/mod.rs:2089-2098); guard length activation_key_guard.rs:11-12 (1 s)

precondition: [key: Esc] top view is ListSelectionView (prefer_esc_to_handle_key_event true)
behaviour: Esc goes straight to the view's handle_key_event, so the list's cancel binding decides; the host does not call on_ctrl_c first.

precondition: [key: Esc] top view does not prefer Esc
behaviour: Esc calls on_ctrl_c first; if Handled and the view completes, it is popped with its completion and the key is not forwarded.
notes: not reached by ListSelectionView (prefer true); generic path for other views

precondition: [host: key with no view open] no view open; task running
behaviour: The task interrupt is taken only when the view stack is empty; with a list open, the key reaches the view.

precondition: view open; no warnings; questions not expanded
behaviour: Ctrl+C is offered to the top view's on_ctrl_c; if Handled and the view completes, it is popped with its completion; the quit hint is not shown because DOUBLE_PRESS_QUIT_SHORTCUT_ENABLED is false.
notes: NotHandled returns to the app; offline exit in app.rs:1062-1080 is not a candidate

precondition: view open
behaviour: Paste goes to the top view only; with a view open the composer receives nothing.
notes: composer branch only when the stack is empty

precondition: top view is a list and its search field is not visible
behaviour: The list returns false for the paste; nothing is inserted and no view completion happens.

precondition: search field visible on a searchable list
behaviour: Pasted text is normalised (split on whitespace, rejoined with single spaces), appended to the query and the list is re-filtered; whitespace-only paste is ignored.
notes: normalize_pasted_search_query is in clipboard_paste.rs (carried by the reuse map)

precondition: top view completes on paste
behaviour: A completed view clears the whole stack (not one pop) and on_active_view_complete runs.
notes: generic host rule; a list never completes on paste

precondition: [host: pre-draw tick] view open
behaviour: Each pre-draw tick ticks the top view; if it is complete the whole stack is cleared (not popped) and on_active_view_complete runs.
notes: clear, not pop: parent dismiss flags are not consulted on this path

precondition: [host: view completes with Accepted] top view completion is Accepted
behaviour: pop_active_view_with_completion removes the top view, then pops each parent whose dismiss_after_child_accept is true, then runs on_view_stack_depth_decreased.

precondition: [host: view completes with Cancelled] top view completion is Cancelled
behaviour: pop removes only the top view and clears the dismiss_after_child_accept flag on the new top; no parent is popped.

precondition: [host: view stack emptied] pop or depth decrease leaves the stack empty
behaviour: on_view_stack_depth_decreased resets the key chord and, when empty, runs on_active_view_complete (resumes the status timer).

precondition: [host: push] any view
behaviour: push_view resets the key chord, pushes the view, schedules an active-view frame and requests a redraw; show_view is the same call.

precondition: [host: restricted input] mode is not DraftHandoff
behaviour: Clears the view stack, warnings view and delayed approvals, re-enables composer input and forwards the key to the composer.
notes: called from app/reconnect.rs:322-332 (not a candidate)

precondition: [host: offline key] offline; top view does not accept input when disconnected
behaviour: The key is not routed to the view; the restricted path runs and clears the stack.
notes: app.rs and app/reconnect.rs are not candidates; list default is false (list_selection_view.rs:294)

precondition: [host: offline Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D] offline; top view does not accept input; no warnings
behaviour: Ctrl+C exits the app; Ctrl+D exits when the composer is empty and no modal is active.
notes: not a candidate

precondition: [host: shutdown] shutdown in progress
behaviour: show_shutdown_in_progress clears the view stack and the warnings view.

precondition: [host: approval request] a list view is top
behaviour: push_approval_request asks the top view try_consume_approval_request first; ListSelectionView does not implement it, so the approval is shown or queued over the list.
notes: approval-specific; the list is only the view under it

precondition: [host: delayed approval] view stack not empty
behaviour: Delayed approval requests are not shown while any view is open.
notes: approval-specific

precondition: [host: attach image] view open
behaviour: attach_image is ignored while any view is open.

precondition: [host: composer copy and mouse] view open
behaviour: Composer copy is not current, copy is refused and mouse preparation returns early while a view is open.
notes: guards are has_active_view checks

precondition: [host: flush paste burst] view open
behaviour: The flush hook also flushes the top view; the list does not override the trait hook, so it contributes nothing.
notes: list uses trait defaults (no override in list_selection_view.rs)

precondition: [host: show_selection_view] caller opens a list
behaviour: Applies the standard footer and secondary-key rules, builds a ListSelectionView with the app's list keymap and pushes it.

precondition: [host: standard footer] allow_cancel true; footer_hint none or the standard line
behaviour: The footer is replaced by picker_hint_line_for_keymap (accept and cancel labels from the list keymap); a custom footer is kept.

precondition: [host: standard footer] allow_cancel false
behaviour: The standard footer is removed when none or standard; a custom footer is kept.

precondition: [host: secondary keys] items carry a secondary action whose key is a configured list action
behaviour: apply_standard_popup_hint removes that secondary action; it looks at top-level items only, so tab items keep theirs.
notes: RISK: tab items are not stripped (see tabs rows)

precondition: [host: replace if active] top view has the view id
behaviour: Pops the top view and builds a new list; a searchable params restores the old query with set_search_query; the dismiss flag is not kept.
notes: see the defect row for search_query

precondition: [host: replace if active, searchable OnDemand] old view's search is closed (search_active false)
behaviour: search_query is read through the trait, which returns Some('') for any searchable view, so set_search_query opens the search field the user did not open.
notes: DEFECT (static, not run): config panel refresh (chatwidget/config_panel.rs:196-209) replaces an OnDemand view; no candidate test covers it

precondition: [host: replace if present] a matching view exists anywhere in the stack
behaviour: Replaces the newest matching view in place without disturbing views above; keeps its dismiss flag; does not restore query or selection.

precondition: [host: replace view if present] a matching view exists
behaviour: Replaces the newest matching view of any type in place; no-op when absent.

precondition: [host: replace active views] top view id is in view_ids
behaviour: Pops consecutive matching views from the top and pushes one new list; query and selection are not restored.

precondition: [backend-confirm: toggle completion] top view has the view id
behaviour: Forwards complete_selection_toggle(index) to the top view only; buried views are not updated.

precondition: [host: dismiss active view if id] top view has the id
behaviour: Pops the top view and requests a redraw; otherwise a no-op.

precondition: [host: dismiss view by id] a matching view exists
behaviour: Removes the newest matching view in place; resets the key chord only when it was the active view.

precondition: [host: constructed view] view pushed
behaviour: not a candidate: the presenter reads selected_index_for_present_view and active_tab_id_for_active_view (mod.rs:1697-1710 region)
notes: not a candidate

precondition: [host: presentation] params.presentation Centered
behaviour: A Centered view is floated over its parent (has_centered_view); Inline is the default; confirmation() is the only Centered preset.

precondition: [key: any] [key (all)] all keys routed to the list
behaviour: Arms are matched top-down; an earlier arm shadows a later one. While the search field is visible, plain printable keys are reserved for the query, so j, k, and similar do not navigate.
notes: shadowing rule for every arm below

precondition: [key: search_toggle_key] press is not a list action; selected row has a toggle
behaviour: Toggles the selected row when the optional non-text search_toggle_key is pressed.
notes: list action wins over the toggle key

precondition: [key: move_up] plain navigation allowed (search hidden or non-plain key)
behaviour: Moves the selection up with wrap, skips disabled rows and fires the selection callback only when the actual item changed.
notes: 'k' edits the query instead when search is visible

precondition: [key: move_down] plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Moves the selection down with wrap, skips disabled rows and fires the selection callback only when the actual item changed.

precondition: [key: page_up] plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Moves up by the rendered row count, clamped at the top (no wrap), then skips disabled rows upward.

precondition: [key: page_down] plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Moves down by the rendered row count, clamped at the end (no wrap), then skips disabled rows downward.

precondition: [key: jump_top] plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Selects the first row, or the first enabled row after it when the first row is disabled.

precondition: [key: jump_bottom] plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Selects the last row, or the nearest enabled row above it when trailing rows are disabled; does not wrap.

precondition: [key: move_left] tabs enabled; plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Switches to the previous tab, wrapping from the first to the last.

precondition: [key: move_right] tabs enabled; plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Switches to the next tab, wrapping from the last to the first.

precondition: [key: Esc] on-demand search active
behaviour: Closes the on-demand search and clears its query; the list stays open. This arm comes before the cancel arm, so Esc does not cancel while the search is open.

precondition: [key: Enter] on-demand search active
behaviour: Accepts the selected row as Primary; the search stays open unless the action completes the view.
notes: with no selected row this is the cancel path (see accept rows)

precondition: [key: Backspace] search field visible
behaviour: Removes the last query character and re-filters.

precondition: [key: Space] selected row has a toggle; no list binding for Space; search hidden, or Immediate with empty query
behaviour: Toggles the selected row (flip, pending count +1, action sent).
notes: the test covers the search case, where this arm does not fire

precondition: [key: Space] Immediate search with empty query; selected row has a toggle placeholder
behaviour: Space is swallowed: no toggle and no query text.

precondition: [key: cancel] allow_cancel; plain-char actions allowed
behaviour: Calls on_ctrl_c: on_cancel runs and the view becomes Cancelled, unless an on-demand search is open. Arm 15 is above accept, so a cancel key rebound to Enter wins over accept.

precondition: [key: accept] accept key bound; plain-char actions allowed
behaviour: Accepts the selected row as Primary, passing the physical key on.

precondition: [key: secondary] selected row has a secondary action whose key is pressed; plain navigation allowed
behaviour: Accepts the row as Secondary: only the secondary action runs; dismissal rules are the same as Primary.

precondition: [key: search opener (OnDemand)] searchable; search not active; OnDemand binding matches; no chord prefix
behaviour: Opens the search field (search_active = true) and consumes the key; the query is unchanged.

precondition: [key: ctrl-letter (unbound)] key is a control char or an unbound Ctrl+letter
behaviour: Swallowed: no action and no query text.

precondition: [key: Ctrl+P (remapped)] list move_down rebound to Ctrl+P
behaviour: Ctrl+P moves the selection down; the default Ctrl+P move_up binding no longer applies.

precondition: [key: printable char] search field visible; no Ctrl or Alt
behaviour: Appends the character to the query and re-filters (state reset when the item source changes).

precondition: [key: row shortcut] list is not searchable; a row's display_shortcut or child_label matches and the row is enabled
behaviour: Selects that row through select_shortcut, which accepts it unless it needs explicit confirmation.
notes: RISK: the first branch searches self.items while select_shortcut indexes active_items(); they differ only when tabs and items are both non-empty

precondition: [key: digit] list is not searchable; auto_number_shortcuts true
behaviour: Digit N selects the Nth enabled non-child row of the active items; ten or more is not reachable by a single key.

precondition: [key: other] none of the arms above matched
behaviour: Ignored.

precondition: [view hook: presentation / keymap_contexts] any
behaviour: Reports the presentation from params and the List keymap context.

precondition: [view hook: accepts_input_when_disconnected] app offline
behaviour: Returns the param, which defaults to false; a picker must opt in to take input while disconnected.

precondition: [view hook: handle_key_event] host forwards a key
behaviour: Delegates to handle_key_event_with_activation_key with no activation key.

precondition: [view hook: is_complete / completion] after accept or cancel
behaviour: Reports whether a completion was set and which one (Accepted or Cancelled).

precondition: [view hook: dismiss_after_child_accept] parent of an accepted child
behaviour: Reports and clears the parent flag set by dismiss_parent_on_child_accept.

precondition: [view hook: view_id] any
behaviour: Reports the view id used by replace and dismiss by id.

precondition: [view hook: selected_index] presenter reads a view
behaviour: Returns the selected actual index.

precondition: [view hook: selection_toggle_states] presenter reads toggle state
behaviour: Returns the toggle state of each active row.

precondition: [backend-confirm: complete_selection_toggle] index is a row in the active items
behaviour: Decrements the row's pending toggle count (saturating).

precondition: [view hook: search_query] searchable list
behaviour: Returns Some(query) for every searchable view, even when the on-demand search is closed (Some('')); the host reads it on replace.
notes: DEFECT input for the replace row (static, not run)

precondition: [view hook: active_tab_id] tabs
behaviour: Returns the active tab id.

precondition: [view hook: on_ctrl_c (search open)] on-demand search active
behaviour: Closes the search (Handled); the list is not completed.

precondition: [view hook: on_ctrl_c (cancel not allowed)] allow_cancel false
behaviour: Returns NotHandled, so the host passes the key on.

precondition: [view hook: on_ctrl_c (cancel)] allow_cancel true; no search open
behaviour: Runs on_cancel and sets Cancelled; the host pops the view.

precondition: [view hook: cursor_pos] on-demand search active
behaviour: Returns the search cursor position recorded at render; otherwise no cursor.

precondition: [view hook: desired_height] any width
behaviour: Height is chrome (header, header gap, tab bar, search, rows up to max_visible_rows, footer and note) and the Panel surface adds its frame; header gap is zero when the header is empty.

precondition: [view hook: render (order)] any
behaviour: Draws, in order: header, header elision, tab bar, search line, rows with scroll indicators, side content, footer note, footer hint; resets rendered_item_count first.

precondition: [key: Space] [toggle (Space, Enter on checkbox row)] selected row enabled and has a toggle
behaviour: Flips is_on, increments pending_toggle_actions and calls the toggle action with the new state.

precondition: [key: accept] [accept: checkbox row] Primary accept on a checkbox_toggle row
behaviour: Toggles the row instead of accepting it, records the last selected index and returns without dismissal.

precondition: [key: accept] [accept: disabled row] selected row is disabled or has a disabled reason
behaviour: Nothing happens: no action, no dismissal, no cancel.

precondition: [key: accept] [accept: Primary actions] enabled row; Primary accept
behaviour: Runs each row action, then on_accept_key with the physical key.

precondition: [key: accept] [accept: dismiss_on_select] row sets dismiss_on_select
behaviour: Completes the view as Accepted; the host pops it and any parents flagged for dismissal.

precondition: [key: accept] [accept: dismiss parent on child accept] row sets dismiss_parent_on_child_accept and not dismiss_on_select
behaviour: Flags the parent so it is popped when this child is accepted.

precondition: [key: accept] [accept: no selected row] selected_actual_idx is None (empty or no-match list)
behaviour: Runs on_cancel and completes the view as Cancelled.

precondition: [key: secondary] [accept: Secondary] row has a secondary action
behaviour: Runs only the secondary action (no Primary actions) and then applies the same dismissal rules.

precondition: [key: row shortcut] [select_shortcut: row needs explicit confirmation] shortcut or number selects a row with require_explicit_confirmation
behaviour: Highlights the row and fires the selection callback if the actual row changed; does not accept.

precondition: [key: row shortcut] [select_shortcut: normal row] shortcut or number selects a row without confirmation
behaviour: Highlights the row and accepts it as Primary with the key.

precondition: [key: move_down] [callback: on selection change] a navigation key changes the actual row
behaviour: on_selection_changed(actual) fires only when the actual selected item changed.
notes: fire_selection_changed is not a candidate (list_selection_view.rs:972-978)

precondition: [key: printable char] [callback: filter or construction changes the actual row] apply_filter changes the actual selection
behaviour: Fires the callback, including when the initial or current highlight is set at construction.
notes: not a candidate: the construction firing is the same callback

precondition: [key: move_right] [tabs: switch] tabs enabled; move_left or move_right
behaviour: Wraps to the next or previous tab; clears the query unless search_items is non-empty; resets the scroll state; selects the first enabled row if none; fires the callback.

precondition: [tabs: first enabled row] construction with tabs and no initial index; tab switch with no selection
behaviour: Selects the first enabled row of the active tab.

precondition: [search: set_search_query] host restores a query (replace or initial)
behaviour: Opens the search (search_active = true even when the query is empty), sets the query, and either resets the selection (source changed) or keeps the previous actual row as the initial selection.
notes: see the defect row: an empty query opens the search

precondition: [key: Esc] [search: stop_on_demand_search] on-demand search closed by Esc or Ctrl+C
behaviour: Sets search_active false and clears the query.

precondition: [take_last_selected_index] caller reads after accept
behaviour: Returns the actual index of the last accepted row and clears it.
notes: not a candidate for keys; callers not checked

precondition: [key: move_down] [skip_disabled variants] navigation lands on a disabled row
behaviour: Wrapping variants skip disabled rows by wrapping; clamped variants search forward then backward and stay put when none is enabled.

precondition: [key: move_down] [ScrollState navigation] any navigation or filter change
behaviour: ScrollState wrap, clamp and page helpers; the empty list clears the selection.

precondition: [ScrollState ensure_visible] selection moves or the list changes
behaviour: Keeps the selected row inside the visible window.

precondition: [apply_vertical_action] not used by ListSelectionView
behaviour: Used by other views only.
notes: noise for S14 (no list call site)

precondition: [key: printable char] [edit_search_query] query edit (type, backspace, paste)
behaviour: Resets the selection when the item source flips between search items and normal items, then re-filters.

precondition: [active item source] any read
behaviour: Uses search_items when the query is non-empty and search_items is non-empty; otherwise the active tab's items, otherwise items. active_items_mut mirrors it.

precondition: [apply_filter: query filter] searchable list with a non-empty query
behaviour: Keeps rows whose search_value contains the query case-insensitively; otherwise all active rows are listed.

precondition: [apply_filter: selection kept] any filter change
behaviour: Keeps the visible position of the selection when it still exists, else the previously selected actual row; falls back to the first enabled row, then row 0.

precondition: [apply_filter: initial and current highlight] construction or preserved selection; list not searchable
behaviour: Uses initial_selected_idx once (taken), then the is_current row when the list is not searchable.
notes: initial_selected_idx is consumed on first apply_filter

precondition: [constructor normalisation] any params
behaviour: max_visible_rows is raised to at least 1; search starts active when Immediate or when an initial query is given; search_placeholder kept only when searchable; tabs select the initial tab or tab 0.

precondition: [ListSelectionView fields: plumbing] field set at construction
behaviour: Carries display and sender fields without behaviour of their own: app_event_tx (sender for every send row), dismiss_after_child_accept, rendered_item_count, search_cursor, header, side content, keymap.

precondition: [SelectionViewParams: display fields] params set by caller
behaviour: Carries title, subtitle, footer note and hints, tab footer hints, items, search_items, tabs and header fields without extra behaviour (rendered in the render rows).

precondition: [SelectionViewParams: search and picker fields] params set by caller
behaviour: Carries is_searchable, search_toggle_key, search_mode, auto_number_shortcuts, search_placeholder, col_width_mode, row_display, description_layout, name_column_width, presentation and picker_surface (each used by its own row).

precondition: [SelectionViewParams: layout and side fields] params set by caller
behaviour: Carries max_visible_rows, reserve_result_rows, allow_input_when_disconnected, view_id, side content and stacked side content, preserve_side_content_bg, on_selection_changed, allow_cancel, on_cancel (used by rows above).

precondition: [SelectionViewParams: initial state] params set by caller
behaviour: initial_selected_idx and initial_search_query seed the view.

precondition: [ScrollState and PickerLayoutSizes: plumbing] layout computed
behaviour: ScrollState carries selected_idx and scroll_top; PickerLayoutSizes carries header, header gap, tabs, search, rows and side sizes (rows yield first, chrome retained).

precondition: [GenericDisplayRow: plumbing] row built
behaviour: Carries name, description, category_tag, display_shortcut, name prefix spans and wrap indent into the row layout.
notes: match_indices and wrapped_name are not set by ListSelectionView (noise)

precondition: [ColumnWidthConfig and RenderedRows: plumbing] render computed
behaviour: Carries the column mode, name width and description layout; RenderedRows reports the lines and items drawn and whether rows exist above or below.

precondition: [SelectionTab: plumbing] tabs in params
behaviour: Carries id, label, header and items of each tab.

precondition: [SelectionSecondaryAction and SelectionToggle: plumbing] rows set these
behaviour: Carries the secondary action key, action and footer hint, and the toggle state and action.

precondition: [SelectionItem: name, shortcut, description plumbing] row set by caller
behaviour: Name, name prefix spans, display shortcut and category tag feed the row; description and selected description are picked per state.

precondition: [SelectionItem: disabled fields] row set by caller
behaviour: is_disabled and disabled_reason block accept and navigation; disabled_gutter_marker replaces the number.

precondition: [SelectionItem: child_label] row is a child
behaviour: A child row shows its letter instead of a number and is not counted in the numbering.

precondition: [SelectionItem: actions and accept fields] row set by caller
behaviour: actions, on_accept_key, dismiss_on_select, dismiss_parent_on_child_accept and require_explicit_confirmation drive the accept rows.

precondition: [SelectionItem: footer hints] row set by caller
behaviour: footer_hint and search_footer_hint feed the footer priority.

precondition: [SelectionItem: search_value] row set by caller
behaviour: Text tested against the query (case-insensitive substring).

precondition: [SelectionItem: toggle fields] row set by caller
behaviour: toggle, checkbox_toggle, pending_toggle_actions and toggle_placeholder drive the toggle rows and the row prefix.

precondition: [ListSelectionView.is_current preselect] list not searchable
behaviour: Preselects the current row when no selection is kept.
notes: see apply_filter rows

precondition: [render: header and gap] title or subtitle set
behaviour: The header renders, followed by header_gap blank rows (default 1; inline banners use 0); tabs and rows follow.

precondition: [render: header elision] header clipped and search field hidden
behaviour: Header renders in the area above a line '[… N lines]' plus the header view-all hint and ' view all', dim.
notes: not drawn while the search is visible

precondition: [header height for tabs] active tab header has height 0
behaviour: Falls back to the base header; reserve_result_rows reserves the tallest tab header.

precondition: [render: tab bar] tabs present
behaviour: Draws the tab bar with the active tab styled, '‹' or '›' on a side with hidden tabs when the width is at least 5 or 7, and truncation with ellipsis.

precondition: [render: search placeholder] search field visible; query empty; placeholder set
behaviour: The placeholder is drawn dim in place of the query.

precondition: [render: on-demand search line] on-demand search active
behaviour: Draws 'Search › ' (cyan bold) before the query, styles the line active, and places the cursor after the query (clamped to width minus one).

precondition: [render: Immediate search line] search field visible and not on-demand
behaviour: Draws only the query (or placeholder) with no label.

precondition: [render: no matches] zero rows after filtering
behaviour: Draws 'no matches' dim and italic in the row area; the search line stays visible.

precondition: [render: row display mode] row_display Wrapped or SingleLine
behaviour: Wrapped rows wrap in the columns; SingleLine rows truncate; rendered_item_count is set from the result.

precondition: [render: scroll indicators] rows above or below the window
behaviour: Draws ↑ at the top and ↓ at the bottom of column 0 in the accent colour; only when the area is at least 3 high.

precondition: [gutter: numbering (auto_number on)] not searchable; auto_number_shortcuts true
behaviour: Enabled non-child rows get 1–9 in visible order; child rows show their letter; disabled rows show disabled_gutter_marker or blanks; rows past nine show blanks.
notes: numbers count visible rows; digit keys count active items; the two agree for non-searchable lists

precondition: [gutter: searchable list] is_searchable
behaviour: No numbers: the gutter is only the selection prefix, since digits go to the query.

precondition: [gutter: auto_number off] auto_number_shortcuts false
behaviour: Gutter shows the row's display_shortcut label when it has one.

precondition: [row name: current marker] row is_current
behaviour: Name gets ' (current)' appended; the selected row has the '›' prefix.

precondition: [row name: toggle prefix] row has a toggle or toggle_placeholder
behaviour: Prefix text: '[*] ' on, '[x] ' on for checkbox rows, '[ ] ' off, and placeholders '[-] ' and '[!] '.

precondition: [row name: shortcut suffix] display_shortcut set and auto_number on
behaviour: A '(key)' suffix is appended to the name.

precondition: [row: disabled text] disabled_reason set or is_disabled
behaviour: Name gets '(disabled)' after it; description becomes 'desc (disabled: reason)' in Columns, reason only in narrow hide or below modes, and 'disabled: reason' when there is no description.

precondition: [row: wrap indent] no description and no disabled reason
behaviour: Wrapped lines indent by the prefix width.

precondition: [row: selected description] row selected and selected_description set
behaviour: The selected row shows selected_description instead of description.

precondition: [row: selected and disabled style] selected row; disabled row
behaviour: Selected row uses the shared accent style across the full width (Panel); disabled rows are dimmed; other rows use the text accent.

precondition: [row: description column] Columns layout
behaviour: Description placed in a column computed from the widest name; the column hides when it does not fit; '(disabled)' is measured.

precondition: [row: HideWhenNarrow and SelectedBelowWhenNarrow] narrow width
behaviour: HideWhenNarrow hides the description; SelectedBelowWhenNarrow shows the selected description under the list and replaces the footer note.

precondition: [row: name column width override] name_column_width set
behaviour: Left column uses the override width; the description column moves right.

precondition: [row: column width mode] AutoVisible or AutoAllRows
behaviour: AutoAllRows keeps the column width stable while scrolling; AutoVisible recomputes for visible rows.

precondition: [row: long names wrap] Wrapped row display
behaviour: Long option text wraps inside its columns without overflow; width changes keep all rows visible.

precondition: [row: halfwidth sound marks] narrow width with halfwidth characters
behaviour: Halfwidth sound marks are counted as two columns in truncation and wrapping.

precondition: [row: narrow preserves third option] narrow width 24
behaviour: Narrow width keeps the third option visible.

precondition: [row: model picker at width 80] width 80
behaviour: Current row marker and wrapped description render as in the picker snapshot.

precondition: [row: halfwidth fuzzy emoji alignment] fuzzy match
behaviour: not a candidate for S14: ListSelectionView never sets match_indices

precondition: [render: picker surface] Panel or Terminal
behaviour: Panel draws a menu surface and reserves the chrome; Terminal draws none; rows yield space first.

precondition: [render: picker layout sizes] any height
behaviour: Chrome (header, tabs, search, footer) stays; rows shrink first; enlarge keeps query and selection.

precondition: [render: page size] rendered rows known
behaviour: PageUp and PageDown move by the rendered row count.

precondition: [render: max rows] any
behaviour: max_visible_rows defaults to 8 (MAX_POPUP_ROWS) and is clamped to at least 1; visible rows is min(max, rendered).

precondition: [render: reserve_result_rows] reserve_result_rows true
behaviour: Header area reserves the tallest tab header; result area keeps its row budget when filtering shrinks it.

precondition: [render: footer note] footer_note set
behaviour: Note lines render above the hint, indented two columns and clipped to the footer height.

precondition: [render: footer hint priority] row or tab or view footer
behaviour: Chooses: on-demand search_footer_hint, then row footer_hint, then row secondary footer_hint, then tab footer hint, then view footer_hint.

precondition: [render: footer hint] hint lines
behaviour: Hint renders dim, indented two columns.

precondition: [render: side content (side by side)] side content and width at least side_content_min_width
behaviour: Side content renders beside the list with the configured width mode.

precondition: [render: stacked side content] side-by-side does not fit
behaviour: Stacked side content, or the side content itself when absent, renders below the list.

precondition: [render: side content clearing] side content rendered
behaviour: The side area is cleared (symbols and style) before drawing, including with a non-zero buffer origin.
notes: tests only

precondition: [render: side background preserved] preserve_side_content_bg true
behaviour: Side content keeps its background colours after rendering.

precondition: [render: shared picker tests (tiny viewports)] tiny viewport
behaviour: Typing in a tiny viewport goes to the query; down arrows and tiny renders do not change the query or selection.

precondition: [render: overflow arrows follow surface] Panel and Terminal surfaces
behaviour: Scroll arrows take the accent colour that fits the painted background.

precondition: [tests: S14 host and approval dismiss] approval or app-server request
behaviour: dismiss_app_server_request removes matching buried views; approval-specific, not a list rule.
